sentences.text: Actinomyces dentalis was described from a filamentous, beaded, Gram-positive, rod-shaped bacterium isolated from pus of a human dental abscess.
Comparative 16S rRNA gene sequencing showed the bacterium represents a distinct subline within the genus Actinomyces, clustering within a group of species that includes Actinomyces bovis.
In supra- and subgingival plaque from twenty patients with chronic periodontitis and fifteen healthy subjects, Actinomyces dentalis was found in a higher percentage in the periodontitis group.
In plaque biofilms from Thai children aged 6 to 15 years, Actinomyces dentalis was one of five health-associated species enriched in caries-free controls rather than in severe dental fluorosis.
